notes: The sheet is a typescript with handwritten mathematical infills, several handwritten additions, and both typewriter and pen cancellations. No diagram or independent drawing occurs.
Title: “Résumé de quelques résultats de Kostant (sous groupes simples de rang 1).” The bibliographical month/year Oct.1959 belongs to the cited reference, not to a stated composition date.

The opening defines G as semisimple over a characteristic-zero field and introduces its Lie algebra. Theorem 1(i) lists conditions involving x,e, weight spaces, adjoint maps and an Sl(2,k) homomorphism, followed by consequences and uniqueness. These assertions were read, not proved.

Part (ii) asserts existence for nilpotent e, describes a handwritten uniqueness qualification, and begins a conjugacy statement under a centralizer. The last sentence is unfinished on this sheet: “les f en question (ou encore les”.
The scan’s lower-left archive number is 15. It is recorded only in a TeX comment. No authorial page number or composition date is visible.

Visible editorial hesitation is recorded through the cancelled b′) and the several revised phrases. The question marks in reading.tex are transcription doubts, not question marks asserted to be on the manuscript.
The blank after “propre de” is genuinely empty in the viewed half. The expected operator was not supplied.
The sign conflict in b) and the e=0 / u≠1 wording prompted ink checks. Both written signs were retained; a detached slash next to i.e. was transcribed at its actual position, not moved onto e=0.

The raised typed “par” has no visible caret. Its placement above the cancelled words and the farther-right raised Z= are represented in a small TikZ layout, without selecting a grammatical insertion point.

All text and formula groups in both halves were compared, including witness agreements; handwritten wrapper differences alone were not counted. The explicit C label of cancelled et as handwritten and the explicit H claim that the raised hypothesis is handwritten were separately assessed against their typewriter forms.
Source dimensions: whole 1670×2143; half a 1670×1151; half b 1670×1152. All reported bounding boxes are in whole-image coordinates.
